% Beamer source: a verbatim-bearing frame, the ordinary Beamer spelling.
% Under ltx-talk the equivalent needs frame* (C-VERBATIM) -- but frame* alone is
% NOT sufficient: it re-tokenises its body, which under \DocumentMetadata emits
% unbalanced tagging structures that listings cannot survive (C-FRAMESTAR-TAG).
% One real 68-page deck with 13 PDDL listings produced 70 errors.
\documentclass{beamer}
\usepackage{listings}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}[containsverbatim]
\frametitle{Gripper domain}
\begin{lstlisting}
(define (domain gripper)
  (:requirements :strips))
\end{lstlisting}
\end{frame}
\end{document}
